10/S0.subgoal: Explain what cybersickness/VIMS is, identify symptoms that indicate its onset, and why reducing it matters for VR usability.

10/S1.subgoal: Describe the causes framework for cybersickness and the internal user-related factors that can increase susceptibility.

10/S2.subgoal: Describe how external hardware factors such as resolution, latency, latency jitter, display type, and input method can cause or increase cybersickness.

10/S3.subgoal: Summarize the internal and hardware causes covered and preview the remaining VR-content causes.
